doc.title: Jimmy and Jeannie Cheatham interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998

title: Jeannie's lyrics
summary: MR quotes lines from a Jeannie Cheatham song; Helen Dance loves it.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Well you’re quite a poet I have to say. I had to write down one of my favorite lines of yours: “You brought me a brand new hatchet/to cut down my weeping willow tree.”
Thank you. That’s Helen Dance’s favorite song by the way.
Yeah it is. Yeah. She says, “Don’t tell Stanley. That’s my favorite — don’t tell Stanley.”
I may have to say that.
It’s a real woman song. Like a declaration.
